Name: Horse with a horn
Author: pennypurple
Description:
[b][u]Install[/u][/b] 
1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI﻿[/url].
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿[/url].
3. Extract the zip into your Stardew Valley\Mods folder.
4. Run the game!

[b][u]How to change the style without mod config[/u][/b]
1. Go to your Mods/Horse with a horn/config.json file
2. In the config.json change the "Pastel" to "Dark" for the dark version or vice versa
3. Run the game!

Downloads.Description:
- Added a new color option for the unicorn
- Changed the original unicorn to have a longer mane
- Added compatibility with Generic Mod Config Menu to switch between the two styles

Manifest.Name: Horse With A Horn
Manifest.Description: Changes the look of the horse to a unicorn.
